CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT

BETWEEN:
(1) Kingfisher Whitecross Ltd (company number 01762155) whose registered office is at 34 Sycamore Crescent, London, SW1P 4ST ("the Company"); and
(2) Xin Liu of 16 Alexandra Street, Hull, HU4 7ZA ("you" or "the Employee").

Employee details
Staff ID: E170033
Personal email: liu.x@icloud.com
Mobile: 07573 445778
Start date: 3 November 2026

SECTION 1 - COMMENCEMENT AND PROBATION
1.1  You will be on probation for 3 months. We may extend this period if we need more time to assess your performance.

1.2  Your employment starts on November 3, 2026, and your period of continuous employment begins on that date.

SECTION 2 - JOB TITLE AND DUTIES
2.1  Your job title is Nurse. A job description has been given to you but it does not form part of this contract.

SECTION 3 - HOURS OF WORK
3.1 Your normal hours are 16 hours per week, Monday to Friday, between 9am and 5.30pm with an unpaid lunch break of 30 minutes.

3.2	You agree to opt out of the 48-hour average weekly limit under the Working Time Regulations 1998. You may withdraw this agreement by giving three months' written notice.

SECTION 4 - PAY
4.1	Your salary is £58,000.00 per year, paid monthly in arrears on or around the 25th of each month by credit transfer.

4.2  Your salary will be reviewed each April. There is no obligation to increase it.

SECTION 5 - HOLIDAYS
5.1  Your holiday entitlement is 28 days per year including bank holidays, pro rata for part-time staff.

5.2  Holiday not taken by the end of the year will be lost unless the law requires it to be carried forward.

SECTION 6 - SICKNESS ABSENCE
6.1	Statutory Sick Pay is payable in line with current rules. Company sick pay of 8 weeks at full pay applies after probation.

SECTION 7 - PENSION
7.1  You will be enrolled into the The People's Pension pension scheme. You may opt out within one month of enrolment.

SECTION 8 - NOTICE
8.1 During any notice period we may place you on garden leave and you must not contact clients.

8.2	The notice period is four weeks' on either side, increasing in line with the Employment Rights Act 1996 where that is longer.

SECTION 9 - EXPENSES
9.1 Business mileage in your own car is paid at 45p per mile for the first 10,000 miles in a tax year.

SECTION 10 - RESTRICTIONS AFTER EMPLOYMENT
10.1	You must not, for 9 months after leaving, try to entice away any employee of the Company with whom you worked closely.

SECTION 11 - FAMILY LEAVE
11.1  Details of family-friendly leave, including time off for dependants, are set out in the Staff Handbook.

SECTION 12 - CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA
12.1	Your data will be held securely and only for as long as necessary, as set out in our staff privacy notice.

SECTION 13 - DISCIPLINE AND GRIEVANCE
13.1  Our disciplinary and grievance procedures are in the Staff Handbook and do not form part of your contract. They follow the ACAS Code of Practice.

SECTION 14 - RIGHT TO WORK
This offer is conditional on you proving your right to work in the UK. We have seen your passport, number 186163092).

For the Company
..............................
Name: Gail Butcher
Position: Managing Director
Date: 9 October 2026

EMPLOYEE ACCEPTANCE

Name: Xin Liu
Date: ________

Initials: XL
